text: Defect found after this item closed, 19 November 2026: release_catalog was not in the profile that `migrate --runtime-role` grants the serving database login, so every acceptance through a running service failed with repository_failure. The local gate passed because its fixtures connect as the schema owner; the hosted demo-instance job failed on commit 7000535. Fixed by adding the table to PostgresDatabase.grantRuntime. ServicePrivilegesSuite now accepts with the service's wiring (fails without the grant), and check-service-package.py accepts a release over HTTP through the serving login. Rule: a new table the service writes goes in grantRuntime, and scripts/check-demo-instance.sh runs locally before a push that touches schema, acceptance or grants.
